elements.text: Firmware 3.2 improves range estimates and fixes a display freeze after a factory reset. Install it at the next service with the dealer service tool.
Charge the battery to at least 40 percent before updating. The update takes about 10 minutes; do not switch the bike off during it.

Firmware 3.2 adds error code E-519 on the C-3 and the T-7: the speed sensor signal was lost while riding. Check the magnet on the rear wheel and the sensor cable. The error code documents will list it at their next revision.
